def depth(n):
    if n is None: return 0
    st=[(n,1)]; best=0
    while st:
        x,d = st.pop()
        if d>best: best=d
        if x[2] is not None: st.append((x[2],d+1))
        if x[3] is not None: st.append((x[3],d+1))
    return best
